HARBOR LABS SAMPLE RECORD. Fictional: every name, date and number is invented.
Page 1 of 1
Consent to appointment as registered agent
Filer Agent Services, LLC, by Frank Filer, consents to act as registered agent for
Harbor Labs, LLC in Colorado.
Registered office: 200 Sample Avenue, Example City, Colorado.
Annual fee: $99, due each February 7. The appointment renews each year unless either
side gives 30 days written notice.
Service of process received by the agent is forwarded by email to
jane@harborlabs.example within one business day.
